breakdown.description: The orthotropic stiffness is rotated by -30 degrees instead of the specified +30 degrees
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated to rotate the stiffness by -30 degrees, while the ground truth corrected this to +30 degrees. The agent failed to resolve this, as the final instruction in the generated specification explicitly states to use 'the negative of the material rotation angle for the stiffness transformation'. Since the material rotation angle is +30 degrees, this instruction incorrectly specifies a -30 degree rotation, repeating the original error.
